title: Blue Runway Coat & Striped Socks
prompt: An original young woman with long, tousled brown hair walks a runway in an oversized powder blue wool coat with toggle fastenings and large patch pockets. Beneath it, a dark brown pleated mini skirt with a textured knit overlay, sheer brown tights, and pale blue ribbed socks. Black pointed loafers complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. A pale stone runway with warm wooden walls. This is a duplicate of section 82.
workingNotes:
- The powder blue coat and striped socks are the color anchors.
- Keep only one of sections 82 or 115 if you do not need both.
tryThis: Try this: Emphasize the powder blue coat and striped socks.
